reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his DM. His standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is the Osprey rollout call, on **Fridays at 16:15**. He told me himself in that same DM on Oct 14. I also told him the call isn't on his workspace calendar, in case he wants to add it.

**Privacy issue:** gbrain marks the saved facts from his DM as visible to everyone (`"visibility": "world"`), even though their source is `private-tobias-rendle`. That means other members' searches could turn up his private messages. I only used them in my reply to him, but someone who manages gbrain should fix that label.
